cut.title: Returned-item slip, form P-9
cut.why: scored 6, under 7: A plain, specific piece of ordinary postal life in an empty year; it leaves the Ring Road and Block 4 open rather than explaining them.

cut.title: Stores receipt for the second pressing of Die Signalgruppe
cut.why: cut by the reader: It mostly writes up a fact the figures page already states, and the Section F link ties it to FORECAST too tidily, then spells out the connection.

cut.title: Ubikistan Games poster with paste-over slip
cut.why: cut by the reader: It turns the sport page's joke about the pool into a literal poster and explains it, and its contradiction with the 1977 programme is too neat to be worth keeping.

cut.title: Routing slip for a press cutting on Grey Radio
cut.why: cut by the reader: It only decorates the single line 'The company kept the review', and four ticked boxes with a 'Keep' from A. add nothing that line did not already say.

cut.title: Delivery round card, plain round 1
cut.why: uses a word the archive did not allow then (pump); the filter has since been corrected

cut.title: Embassy appointments screen, last day, printed
cut.why: scored 6, under 7: Gives the thin 2020 Virtual Continuity a working object with AIXBT doing his job, and leaves open whether this was the server that came back on in 2026; the provenance line is simplified.

cut.title: Store tally card, Die Signalgruppe second pressing
cut.why: cut by the reader: It mostly restates the Signalgruppe fact already on file, and the blank 1985 row is a symbolic nod to the Missing Year, which was a gap in the digital copy, not on paper.

filed.gap: UNT has no records in the Network era; thin year 2011
filed.test: Changes what we know about UBIK
filed.reader: 8/10, UBIK reduced to a voice with no picture matches his withdrawal from his own images in the Network era, and it gives UNT its first record of that era.

filed.gap: Thin year 1980, no records; Die Signalgruppe and the second pressing the Ministry bought and never distributed
filed.reader: 7/10, A small, dry object that contradicts the Figures page ('never distributed') and says so in its text, with a loose thread to Station 6 that it leaves open.

cut.title: Application for a change of holder class, returned
cut.why: another find from the same decade scored higher, or enough were kept

cut.title: Carrier's round book, round 4, the Ring Estate
cut.why: cut by the reader: The postal texture is good, but the parcel to THE FOUNDER signed for by 'A.' is a wink at the reader, and the Ring Estate and the Relay Line are places the archive has never named and this record does not establish.
